request: Keep selected profile after terminal agent task completes
title: Preserve workspace when agent tabs close
purpose: Prevent terminal cleanup switching PLUCK back to BOXON

files.purpose: Keep the chosen workspace stable during tab removal.
files.previous_behavior: Fallback selection could choose a different profile user tab and FollowWorkspace switched the workspace.
files.new_behavior: Closing selects current-profile user tabs or remaining agent tabs, suppresses workspace following during removal and opens a current-profile home tab when no visible candidates remain.
files.data_impact: none: changes in-memory tab selection only; existing new-tab/session persistence behavior retained.
files.access_control_impact: none: profile isolation, login permissions and agent ownership checks remain unchanged.
risks: Tab closure fallback changes which remaining agent tab is selected when the current profile has no user tabs.
files.rollback: Revert commit c7c2794 and rebuild the executable. Existing profile and session data stays compatible without migration.

files.purpose: Cover BOXON/PLUCK terminal tab closure and keep the existing native test harness compatible with current constructors and event formats.
files.previous_behavior: No cross-profile terminal cleanup regression; stale reflection arguments prevented the full suite from completing.
files.new_behavior: Regression asserts closing a terminal agent tab selects PLUCK and preserves its workspace with BOXON present; fixtures use current signatures and Codex events.
files.data_impact: none: synthetic tabs only, no operational profile files touched.
files.access_control_impact: none: profile isolation, login permissions and agent ownership checks remain unchanged.
risks: Reflection-based fixtures require maintenance when private signatures change.
files.rollback: Revert commit c7c2794 and rebuild the executable. Existing profile and session data stays compatible without migration.

production_safety.operational_data: No operational profile or credential data was read or modified; regression used synthetic uninitialized tabs.
external_side_effects: Local tests and native/publish-profile-fix build only; active Oinzi was not restarted.

verification.evidence: All 21 assertions passed, including current-profile fallback and workspace preservation.

verification.command: dotnet publish native/native.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o native/publish-profile-fix -p:NoWarn=MSB3277 -v quiet

residual_risks: Live terminal session cleanup not exercised against user data; asynchronous home-tab creation when no visible tabs remain is not covered by this fixture.
Earlier failed test processes may remain pending Windows crash handling; user browser was left running unchanged.
